notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi guys,
first of all thanks for supporting our games! ː16bitHeartː
We wanted to let you know that we released a minor patch today that goes to fix an issue with platforms when pausing the game. Also we have included that when the game ends the game will restart from some previous checkpoint, so that you can complete your card collection if you missed any ː8bitgreyː

still thanks! ː16bitHeartː
